// Must-trip fixture: the unwrap ban and the run-dir pass-through check are keyed
// on the pathfence.Contained TYPE, not on a local's name. A Contained copied into
// a variable no list would think to hold still unwraps.
package scanfixture

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/pathfence"
)

// renamedUnwrap trips the unwrap ban: x is a Contained under a new name.
func renamedUnwrap(c pathfence.Contained) ([]byte, error) {
	x := c
	return os.ReadFile(x.String())
}

// renamedPassOn is the run-dir check's case: a Contained under a name the old
// ledgerPath/outPath/reportPath list never held, unwrapped where it should pass
// through. It opens nothing, so the unwrap ban leaves it to that check.
func renamedPassOn(c pathfence.Contained) {
	renamed := c
	fmt.Println(renamed.String())
}
